changes.title: Count only complete recorded Cleric history
changes.text: Finished Cleric history rows now contribute to the private history facts only when both class and outcome are recorded. Incomplete rows remain unknown instead of being invented as runs; valid wins and deaths are unchanged.

changes.title: Reproduce and retain the incomplete-row boundary
changes.text: A focused regression first failed alone against the prior counter and then passed with the outcome-presence guard. The complete corrected core suite passed 1,832 methods in 362 suites.
